recentItems.title: One month to go until the Dakar 2026 Opening Ceremony! ⭐
recentItems.description:
The Youth Olympic Flame arrives in Africa for the first time as Dakar’s young dancers bring its journey to life through movement, music and vibrant Senegalese energy. Watch the flame pass from hand to hand in a powerful celebration of youth, unity and Olympic spirit on the road to the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games.

recentItems.title: 15 Years Together: Charlène Guignard & Marco Fabbri Dance to "Diamanti" 🇮🇹🎶 | Music Monday
recentItems.description:
📺 Re-live all the #MilanoCortina2026 action: https://go.olympics.com/watch 

Charlène Guignard and Marco Fabbri: 15 years together on and off the ice. At their fourth Olympics, they took bronze in the figure skating team event at Milano Cortina 2026 before narrowly missing a medal in the ice dance and taking fourth on home ice following a truly magical free dance to the "Diamanti" soundtrack.

Relive the best moments from the Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games, featuring elite athletes, thrilling competition, and unforgettable highlights across the world’s top winter sports on the Olympic stage.
